dedupe_keys.name: modalites de gestion et titulaires dsp eau potable

description: Modalités de gestion et titulaires DSP eau potable is a dataset listed in Gpseo open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GPS&O. Identification des délégataires du service public en charge de l'approvisionnement en eau potable pour l'ensemble des communes du territoire. Coverage: Grand Paris Seine et Oise. The portal files it under Administration. Its keywords are eau, administration. The portal shows 73 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License Version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-gpseo-portal.
